remarks: Fantastic deal for this mid-city location, popular complex & walk to everything in downtown.  8th floor viewing of the trees & city, such a beautiful sight. This updated 1 BR unit, has just been freshly painted, stylish laminate vinyl flooring throughout. The kitchen has been updated with white cabinets and gray countertops, has plenty of cabinets & counterspace for food prep. The primary bedroom has double closets, new A/C unit. There are several ways furniture can be arranged. Two windows in the bedroom, provide good lighting & great views. The full bath has tub, shower & gray tile, white floor tile, modern vanity & sink. There are 2 additional closets, both great space for storing either clothes or household goods. Unwind at the end of the day on the balcony with that favorite snack & beverage overlooking treetops and blue skies. Enjoy the complex pool, & gym. CC's include heat, water, & cooking gas. 1 reserved space for parking. For additional spaces there is a charge. Kitchen blind AS IS.
